facts.statement: The Costume Parade community event ran on Friday October 23rd, 2009 on Server 1, with separate times for US/Latin America and UK/Europe.
facts.quote: Friday October 23rd 3pm – 5pm Pacific Time (U.S. and Latin America) Server 1

facts.statement: Players were to bring their pet, wear a favorite costume, and teleport to Blackspore to party for about an hour before marching as a group out of the swamp.
facts.quote: Bring your pet and wear your favorite costume and teleport to Blackspore. We will party for about an hour

facts.statement: After leaving the swamp, the parade was to overrun Crossroads and keep partying there; the organisers also floated dropping headstones so everyone turned into skeletons.
facts.quote: From there we’ll overrun Crossroads where we’ll party some more!

article_summaries.title: Free Realms - What is New? (Community Event: Costume Parade)
article_summaries.summary: A community event announcement for a Costume Parade on Friday October 23rd, 2009, run on Server 1 at two times for US/Latin America and UK/Europe. Players were to bring their pet, wear a costume, teleport to Blackspore, party about an hour, then march out of the swamp into Crossroads. The post date is not printed; the page's relative timestamp ('1 week, 20 hours ago' at capture on 2009-10-30) suggests about October 21, 2009.
